Standalone test copy of BasicSR v1.4.2 RRDBNet. Registry import/decorator removed; arch_util contains only the three required original helper functions. Network math unchanged. Original downloaded sources retained alongside Apache 2.0 license. Real-ESRGAN BSD license retained. URLs and SHA256 recorded in models/generation/upscale/test-provenance.json. Weights are loaded weights_only=True, strict=True; no ComfyUI import/environment. This is an experimental single-frame restorer, not a temporally trained video SR model.
